description: Three-panel side-by-side collage of close-cropped photographs of cable news figures: CNN White House correspondent Jim Acosta at left speaking into a handheld microphone, MSNBC host Rachel Maddow in dark-framed glasses at center, and MSNBC host Chris Matthews at right in front of twin lectern microphones. The layout matches the filename 'acosta-maddow-matthews-sbs' and is the kind of composite used in articles or posts about mainstream media personalities.

Political meme overlaying white block text on a painting of Confederate cavalry officers on horseback fording a river, one carrying a Confederate battle flag, with more mounted troops behind them. The text asserts that Democrats have not been this angry at Republicans 'since we freed their slaves', invoking the Civil War-era party framing; the word 'Democrats' is misspelled 'Demorcrats' in the top line. The underlying artwork is in the style of a modern Civil War history painting; the artist is not credited in the image.
text: DEMORCRATS HAVEN'T BEEN THIS MAD AT REPUBLICANS. SINCE WE FREED THEIR SLAVES
flags: Partisan claim/framing, presented as the meme's assertion, not fact

description: Meme built from a close-up photograph of Donald Trump smirking against a dark background, wearing a white shirt and red tie, with the white caption 'MY TURN...' in the upper left corner. The image conveys anticipation of retaliation or reversal, a common framing in Q-adjacent posts about investigations turning against Trump's opponents.

Higher-resolution version of the same political meme as n=906/907's batch: white outlined text over a detailed painting of Confederate cavalry officers riding out of a river crossing, with a Confederate battle flag carried at left and a column of mounted troops behind. The central gray-bearded officer in a blue-gray coat on a gray horse is consistent with popular depictions of Robert E. Lee, though the painting is uncredited. Unlike the copy attached to post 3171, 'Democrats' is spelled correctly here.
text: DEMOCRATS HAVEN'T BEEN THIS MAD AT REPUBLICANS. SINCE WE FREED THEIR SLAVES

description: Two-column compilation of seven verified tweets, all dated 24 Mar 2019 (the day of the Barr summary of the Mueller report), from Jeff Merkley, Jay Inslee, Mark Warner, Joy Reid, Elizabeth Warren, Kamala Harris, and Tom Steyer, plus quoted tweets from Kyle Griffin and Rep. Jerry Nadler. The word 'handpicked'/'hand-picked' (describing Attorney General William Barr) is highlighted in pink in six of the tweets, and a large caption at bottom right reads 'TALKING POINTS?', implying the similar wording was coordinated. The compilation is the image's claim of coordination; the tweets themselves demand release of the full Mueller report.
text: Senator Jeff Merkley @SenJeffMerkley Follow. Barr was handpicked because he said the president couldn't be charged with obstruction and, guess what? He decided no obstruction! Shocker!. 7:00 PM - 24 Mar 2019. Jay Inslee @JayInslee Follow. The American people deserve the opportunity to read the full Mueller report, not a sanitized summary from Donald Trump's hand-picked AG. The Trump administration has proven it can't be trusted. It's time to #releasethereport. 6:55 PM - 24 Mar 2019. Mark Warner @MarkWarner Follow. Congress and the American people need to see the Special Counsel's full report - not a shorthand summary from the President's handpicked Attorney General. 7:48 PM - 24 Mar 2019. Joy Reid @JoyAnnReid Follow. Good questions. Shouldn't we hear Mueller's conclusions directly from him and not the interpretation from Trump's hand picked AG? Just so everyone can come together around the same set of facts?. Kyle Griffin @kylegriffin1 Joe Scarborough on @MSNBC: "If there was no collusion ... Why did Donald Trump, why did Mike Pence, why did Jeff Sessions, why did the president's first national security adviser, why did the president's campaign chairman ... Why did they all lie about contacts with Russians?". 6:14 PM - 24 Mar 2019. Elizabeth Warren @ewarren Follow. Congress voted 420-0 to release the full Mueller report. Not a "summary" from his handpicked Attorney General. AG Barr, make the full report public. Immediately. 3:33 PM - 24 Mar 2019. Kamala Harris @KamalaHarris Follow. The Mueller report needs to be made public, the underlying investigative materials should be handed over to Congress, and Barr must testify. That is what transparency looks like. A short letter from Trump's hand-picked Attorney General is not sufficient. 4:40 PM - 24 Mar 2019. Tom Steyer @TomSteyer Follow. Robert Mueller concluded that he could NOT exonerate @realdonaldtrump, and Americans deserve to know why. The decision not to prosecute Trump was made by his hand-picked Attorney General based on a false legal premise. Congress must #SubpoenaMueller. (((Rep. Nadler))) @RepJerryNadler In light of the very concerning discrepancies and final decision making at the Justice Department following the Special Counsel report, where Mueller did not exonerate the President, we will be calling Attorney General Barr in to testify before @HouseJudiciary in the near future. 5:32 PM - 24 Mar 2019. TALKING POINTS?
